source.title: 【直播回放】【3D】「星·伊甸」星瞳生日会直播 2025年11月07日19点场

capture_record.independent_after_save_media_state: not separately logged; no playback command issued during native save
capture_record.method: Chrome built-in Save video frame as; download event.path; original PNG copied without resampling

source.dark_mask_definition: 255 where all original RGB channels <=25 (8 bit). Low-signal heuristic only, NOT depth or model confidence.

exclusions.description: Conservative night-city/window region, possible texture/backdrop/reflection, not metric geometry
Conservative moving performer ROI includes some prop/background; not segmentation
Conservative volumetric spotlight and bloom ROI; not a solid surface, overlaps other exclusions

source.provenance: Native source capture-manifest.json; original PNG hash and size independently rechecked by depth script. Full source acquisition evidence retained separately.

value_definition: Relative inverse-depth-like prediction. Larger/white generally nearer, smaller/black generally farther. Not metric distance, not luminance conversion. Per-image min/max normalization is not comparable metric distance across views.
normalization: (raw-min)/(max-min); source-grid display is derived bicubic interpolation align_corners=False, not native-resolution independent depth inference.

mask_definition.manual_exclusions: Conservative incomplete manual ROIs; 0 is unlabelled, NOT valid certification. See source exclusions descriptions.
mask_definition.confidence_unknown: 255 everywhere means no calibrated model confidence, NEVER high confidence.
mask_definition.nonfinite_invalid: 255 indicates nonfinite numeric prediction, 0 merely finite; does not certify geometric validity.
mask_definition.occluded_hidden_regions: Not observable, no hidden geometry or surface contact inferred as fact.

limitations: Single monocular estimate cannot validate metric geometry, hidden structures, scale, camera calibration, or contact.
Stylized CG, reflective/translucent surfaces, lighting, characters and screen overlays can be wrong.
Manual exclusion masks are incomplete and not segmentation.
This analysis does not replace native multi-view evidence or direct unwarped overlay validation.
